input.title: How to make cold brew coffee at home
input.content_html:
Cold brew coffee is easier to make at home than most people expect. It takes a coarse grind, cold water and patience.

How to make cold brew coffee

Add the grounds to a jar, pour in water and wait. However, the wait is the hard part. Therefore plan ahead and start the night before. Read our grinding guide or the cold brew article.

Strain it, dilute it and enjoy. Cold brew coffee keeps for a week in the fridge.
input.meta_description: Learn how to make cold brew coffee at home with a coarse grind and cold water.

input.title: Cold brew vs iced coffee: what is the difference
input.content_html:
Cold brew is steeped for hours. Iced coffee is brewed hot and then cooled. The difference is taste.

Cold brew

Smooth and low in acid.

Iced coffee

Bright and sharp, so it suits milk.
